scope: Synthetic Excel per-sheet export regression. No user financial documents or extracted content included.
changes: Export visible worksheets individually from the private original workbook by temporarily hiding other sheets.
Preserve scale, print areas, manual page breaks and per-sheet paper geometry; no default one-page fitting.
Remove only PDF pages proven to contain no painting operators; preserve text, image, chart, vector and annotation pages.
Keep native Office PDF outputs in the existing approved staging folder; clean partial exports on handled failures.
blank_page_unit_checks: Nonpainting paths, clipping and graphics state are removable.
Text, image XObjects, vector painting, shadings and annotations are kept.
Unknown operators and malformed trailing content are kept.
additional_native_check: A workbook with one populated sheet and one entirely empty sheet exports one page and removes one blank page without a dialog.
limitations: Visibility changes require unprotected workbook structure.
Conservative blank detection retains painted white content and pages with only headers or footers.
Saved print areas and horizontal breaks are honored, including column splits.
